---
title: "Electrical_Coupling_Wilcoxon_Signed_Rank"
author: "Mirja grote Lambers"
date: "2026-05-30"
output: html_document
---

This script uses a non-parametric studentised permutation test for paired data (npar.t.test.paired and nparcomp) to determine whether there is directional asymmetry in coupling strength between pericyte-pericyte and endothelial-pericyte pairs in organotypic hippocampal slice cultures (OHSC) and acute human slice preparations, as measured simultaneously using the dual-patch-clamp method. A cell was hyperpolarized using alternating current pulses of −100 pA. The coupling coefficient CC_100 was calculated as the ratio of the average voltage deflection in the receiving cell to the average voltage deflection in the stimulated cell (V_receiver / V_stimulated). 

H0: CC_100 does not differ between stimulation directions (relative effect p = 0.5; symmetrical coupling)

H1: CC_100 differs between stimulation directions (relative effect p ≠ 0.5; asymmetrical coupling)


library(nparcomp)

coupling_symmetry <- function(csv_file, col_1, col_2, label) {
  df   <- read.csv(csv_file)
  cc_1 <- df[[col_1]]
  cc_2 <- df[[col_2]]
  n    <- length(cc_1)

  df_long <- data.frame(
    CC        = c(cc_1, cc_2),
    condition = factor(rep(c("dir1", "dir2"), each = n))
  )

  cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", label))
  cat(sprintf("n pairs = %d\n",        n))
  cat(sprintf("  %s: median = %.3f\n", col_1, median(cc_1)))
  cat(sprintf("  %s: median = %.3f\n", col_2, median(cc_2)))

  set.seed(42)
  np <- npar.t.test.paired(CC ~ condition, data = df_long,
                          alternative = "two.sided",
                          info        = FALSE,
                          plot.simci  = FALSE,
                          rounds = 6)
  summary(np)
  plot(np)
}

datasets <- list(
  list("Pericyte_Pericyte_Coupling_OHSC.csv",
       "CC_100_1_toward_2", "CC_100_2_toward_1",
       "Pericyte-Pericyte, OHSC"),
  list("Endothelium_Pericyte_Coupling_OHSC.csv",
       "CC_100_endothelia_toward_pericyte", "CC_100_pericyte_toward_endothelia",
       "Endothelium-Pericyte, OHSC"),
  list("Pericyte_Pericyte_Coupling_Human_Acute_Slice.csv",
       "CC_100_1_toward_2", "CC_100_2_toward_1",
       "Pericyte-Pericyte, Human Acute Slice"),
  list("Endothelium_Pericyte_Coupling_Human_Acute_Slice.csv",
       "CC_100_endothelia_toward_pericyte", "CC_100_pericyte_toward_endothelia",
       "Endothelium-Pericyte, Human Acute Slice")
)

for (d in datasets) {
  coupling_symmetry(d[[1]], d[[2]], d[[3]], d[[4]])
}
